plan.reason: High-dimensional (10D) problem with severe stagnation (19) and no recent improvement, so the optimizer needs more exploration and local refinement to escape a flat/uninformative region. Increasing exploration (0.55) and local_fraction (0.5) with a larger radius (0.2) balances novelty-based sampling against predicted-objective exploitation, since distance is only a novelty heuristic, not posterior uncertainty. Auto surrogate lets held-out RMSE pick RBF vs quadratic given few (24) evaluations. current_to_best with higher mutation/crossover keeps population diversity while guiding toward the incumbent, and a moderate population/generations ratio fits the remaining ~76-evaluation budget without over-allocating per generation.
